description: Start the stack (or part of it) detached from the optional projectPath. The result carries `state`: `ready` (every local-process service passed its readiness check), `starting` (launched, readiness not confirmed: the default after a short wait; poll `status`, or pass waitForReady), `failed` (a service exited or gave up; the error carries its own output) or `timeout` (waitForReady was set and readiness was not reached in waitSeconds; it keeps starting). `started: true` never means ready. Fails fast on an unknown service, an unsupported host, or a Tilt already running.

dryRun.description: Show what would be started without starting

force.description: Replace a Tilt that is already running

only.description: Start only these services plus what they depend on and shared infrastructure

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the Flisk project root; run this operation from that directory.

waitForReady.description: Wait until every service passed its readiness check (local-process stacks), instead of only watching for an early failure

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait before returning (default 15, max 60; with waitForReady default 120, max 600)

name: up
